verses.sa:
ॐ इत्येतदक्षरमिदं सर्वं तस्योपव्याख्यानं
भूतं भवद् भविष्यदिति सर्वमोङ्कार एव
यच्चान्यत् त्रिकालातीतं तदप्योङ्कार एव ॥
verses.iast:
oṃ ityetadakṣaramidaṃ sarvaṃ tasyopavyākhyānaṃ
bhūtaṃ bhavad bhaviṣyaditi sarvamoṅkāra eva
yaccānyat trikālātītaṃ tadapyoṅkāra eva ||
verses.en: Om. This syllable is all of this. Here is its explanation. What has been, what is, and what will be: all of it is Om. Whatever else lies beyond the three times, that too is Om.

verses.sa: सर्वं ह्येतद् ब्रह्मायमात्मा ब्रह्म सोऽयमात्मा चतुष्पात् ॥
verses.iast: sarvaṃ hyetad brahmāyamātmā brahma so'yamātmā catuṣpāt ||
verses.en: All of this is Brahman. This Self is Brahman. This Self has four quarters.

verses.sa:
जागरितस्थानो बहिष्प्रज्ञः सप्ताङ्ग एकोनविंशतिमुखः
स्थूलभुग्वैश्वानरः प्रथमः पादः ॥
verses.iast:
jāgaritasthāno bahiṣprajñaḥ saptāṅga ekonaviṃśatimukhaḥ
sthūlabhugvaiśvānaraḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ ||
verses.en: The first quarter is Vaishvanara. Its place is waking. It knows what is outside. It has seven limbs and nineteen mouths, and it takes in the solid world.

verses.sa:
स्वप्नस्थानोऽन्तःप्रज्ञः सप्ताङ्ग एकोनविंशतिमुखः
प्रविविक्तभुक्तैजसो द्वितीयः पादः ॥
verses.iast:
svapnasthāno'ntaḥprajñaḥ saptāṅga ekonaviṃśatimukhaḥ
praviviktabhuktaijaso dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
verses.en: The second quarter is Taijasa. Its place is dream. It knows what is inside. It has seven limbs and nineteen mouths, and it takes in the subtle world.

verses.sa:
यत्र सुप्तो न कञ्चन कामं कामयते न कञ्चन स्वप्नं
पश्यति तत् सुषुप्तम् । सुषुप्तस्थान एकीभूतः प्रज्ञानघन
एवानन्दमयो ह्यानन्दभुक् चेतोमुखः प्राज्ञस्तृतीयः पादः ॥
verses.iast:
yatra supto na kañcana kāmaṃ kāmayate na kañcana svapnaṃ
paśyati tat suṣuptam | suṣuptasthāna ekībhūtaḥ prajñānaghana
evānandamayo hyānandabhuk cetomukhaḥ prājñastṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
verses.en: When a sleeper wants nothing and sees no dream, that is deep sleep. The third quarter is Prajna. Its place is deep sleep. In it everything has become one, a single mass of knowing. It is made of bliss and takes in bliss, and awareness is its door.

verses.sa:
एष सर्वेश्वरः एष सर्वज्ञ एषोऽन्तर्याम्येष योनिः सर्वस्य
प्रभवाप्ययौ हि भूतानाम् ॥
verses.iast:
eṣa sarveśvaraḥ eṣa sarvajña eṣo'ntaryāmyeṣa yoniḥ sarvasya
prabhavāpyayau hi bhūtānām ||
verses.en: This is the lord of all. This knows all. This is the ruler within. This is where everything comes from, for beings arise from it and return to it.

verses.sa:
नान्तःप्रज्ञं न बहिष्प्रज्ञं नोभयतःप्रज्ञं न प्रज्ञानघनं
न प्रज्ञं नाप्रज्ञम् । अदृष्टमव्यवहार्यमग्राह्यमलक्षणं
अचिन्त्यमव्यपदेश्यमेकात्मप्रत्ययसारं प्रपञ्चोपशमं
शान्तं शिवमद्वैतं चतुर्थं मन्यन्ते स आत्मा स विज्ञेयः ॥
verses.iast:
nāntaḥprajñaṃ na bahiṣprajñaṃ nobhayataḥprajñaṃ na prajñānaghanaṃ
na prajñaṃ nāprajñam | adṛṣṭamavyavahāryamagrāhyamalakṣaṇaṃ
acintyamavyapadeśyamekātmapratyayasāraṃ prapañcopaśamaṃ
śāntaṃ śivamadvaitaṃ caturthaṃ manyante sa ātmā sa vijñeyaḥ ||
verses.en: Not turned inward, not turned outward, not both ways at once, not a mass of knowing, not knowing, not unknowing. It cannot be seen, used, grasped or marked. It cannot be thought or named. Its substance is the one steady sense of self. In it the world falls quiet. It is peace, it is good, it is one without a second. This they call the fourth. That is the Self. That is what is to be known.

verses.sa:
सोऽयमात्माध्यक्षरमोङ्कारोऽधिमात्रं पादा मात्रा मात्राश्च
पादा अकार उकारो मकार इति ॥
verses.iast:
so'yamātmādhyakṣaramoṅkāro'dhimātraṃ pādā mātrā mātrāśca
pādā akāra ukāro makāra iti ||
verses.en: This Self, taken as a syllable, is Om. Taken as sounds, the quarters are the sounds and the sounds are the quarters: a, u and m.

verses.sa:
जागरितस्थानो वैश्वानरोऽकारः प्रथमा मात्राऽऽप्तेरादिमत्त्वाद्
वाऽऽप्नोति ह वै सर्वान् कामानादिश्च भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.iast:
jāgaritasthāno vaiśvānaro'kāraḥ prathamā mātrā''pterādimattvād
vā''pnoti ha vai sarvān kāmānādiśca bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
verses.en: Vaishvanara, whose place is waking, is a, the first sound, because it runs through everything and because it comes first. One who knows this gains what they wish for and becomes first.

verses.sa:
स्वप्नस्थानस्तैजस उकारो द्वितीया मात्रोत्कर्षात्
उभयत्वाद्वोत्कर्षति ह वै ज्ञानसन्ततिं समानश्च भवति
नास्याब्रह्मवित्कुले भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.iast:
svapnasthānastaijasa ukāro dvitīyā mātrotkarṣāt
ubhayatvādvotkarṣati ha vai jñānasantatiṃ samānaśca bhavati
nāsyābrahmavitkule bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
verses.en: Taijasa, whose place is dream, is u, the second sound, because it is higher and because it stands between the two. One who knows this carries knowledge forward and is even with everyone. No one in their family is born without knowing Brahman.

verses.sa:
सुषुप्तस्थानः प्राज्ञो मकारस्तृतीया मात्रा मितेरपीतेर्वा
मिनोति ह वा इदं सर्वमपीतिश्च भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.iast:
suṣuptasthānaḥ prājño makārastṛtīyā mātrā miterapītervā
minoti ha vā idaṃ sarvamapītiśca bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
verses.en: Prajna, whose place is deep sleep, is m, the third sound, because it measures and because everything merges into it. One who knows this measures all of this and becomes the place where it merges.

verses.sa:
अमात्रश्चतुर्थोऽव्यवहार्यः प्रपञ्चोपशमः शिवोऽद्वैत
एवमोङ्कार आत्मैव संविशत्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं य एवं वेद ॥
verses.iast:
amātraścaturtho'vyavahāryaḥ prapañcopaśamaḥ śivo'dvaita
evamoṅkāra ātmaiva saṃviśatyātmanā''tmānaṃ ya evaṃ veda ||
verses.en: The fourth has no sound. It cannot be used or handled. In it the world falls quiet. It is good and one without a second. So Om is the Self itself. One who knows this goes into the Self by the Self.
